_comment: The ONLY place where the term's dates live. Course texts never contain dates: module pages say 'at the start of lab N' and Moodle shows the real dates (assignment due dates, course calendar). For a new term: edit this file, run assignments.php on the restored course (or let the Moodle restore shift the dates by the new course start date).
